# CANDIDATE: VWAP_MEAN_REV_RIBBON_FILTER_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price tends to revert to VWAP when extended beyond 1 ATR while the EMA ribbon is bullish, offering a short‑term mean‑reversion edge. The ribbon filter ensures we only take mean‑reversion longs in a bullish micro‑structure, reducing false signals during strong bearish pushes.

## Mechanism

Entry: When price < VWAP - 1*ATR(14) AND EMA9 > EMA20 > EMA50 (ribbon bullish) AND the current 5‑min candle closes bullish (close > open), enter long at the next bar’s open.  
Exit: Chart‑stop at structure invalidation (new lower low breaking recent swing low) or premium‑stop 0.5%; TP1 at 1R, runner trail 10% off HWM.  
Regime hints: Best in low‑VIX (<15) and mid‑morning (10:00‑12:00 ET); avoid strong trending regimes (ADX >25) or high VIX.
